description: Dependency updates for this repository (Cargo, npm, GitHub Actions, Swift packages, XcodeGen packages).
Ordinary updates wait 2 days after a release (an update from a registry that gives no release time waits to be offered) and come grouped by ecosystem.

Only what does not reach the shipped node, the web client, or the release builds merges by itself when CI is green: dev-only npm packages and the GitHub Actions that only CI uses, patch and minor. Every other update, and the weekly lock file refresh, is a pull request for a person to read.
A security fix skips the wait and merges when CI is green.
Every GitHub Action stays pinned to a commit SHA with its tag in a comment. A branch is rebased when it falls behind main, so an up-to-date rule does not leave it behind.

packageRules.description: Dev-only npm packages (test and build tools): patch and minor merge when CI is green. The page does not import them, and CI builds and tests with them; a person reads every other update.
GitHub Actions that only CI uses: patch, minor, and pin updates merge when CI is green. The ones a release workflow uses are the next rule.
A Rust crate before 1.0 may break its interface with a minor release (and several of ours do cryptography): its minor updates are for a person, one pull request each.
A major update is a pull request for a person to read and merge.
This action is pinned to the head of a branch, which has no release date to wait for and no version to read: a person merges its updates.
The GitHub Actions that the release workflows use run with the release's permissions and build what people install: a person reads their updates, as one pull request.
